name: Research
description: Turn questions into research plans, gather and summarise sources with citations, compare competitors and prices, and check claims against their sources.
descriptionFa: تبدیل پرسش‌ها به برنامه‌ی پژوهش، جمع‌آوری و خلاصه‌سازی منابع با ارجاع، مقایسه‌ی رقبا و قیمت‌ها و بررسی ادعاها با منابع آن‌ها.

sampleTasks.title: Plan research on starting a delivery service for a small bakery
sampleTasks.description: Turn the question "should our bakery add local delivery?" into a research plan with sub-questions, the sources we may use, and tasks for the desk researcher and market analyst.

sampleTasks.title: Summarise five articles on customer loyalty programmes
sampleTasks.description: Go through the five articles I put in the folder and write a one-page summary of what each says, with a citation for every point and a short list of agreements and disagreements.

sampleTasks.title: Compare prices of three local competitors
sampleTasks.description: From the price lists and web pages I provide for three invented competitors of a small bakery, build a table comparing prices for ten common products and note the differences.
